collection.description: A villager brings home a lavastone that glows a cold purple, and has not slept well since.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Most lavastones glow warm colors. This one, which (name1) found half buried at the edge of the jungle, glows a deep, cold purple. Since (he/she) brought it home, (he/she) hasn't been sleeping well. (He/She) keeps waking up with a heavy feeling in (his/her) chest, and food doesn't taste of much.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a snack, a basket of fruit); the village's stores do not change

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: After a few days of rest, the fever passes. (name1) wraps the stone in leaves and puts it back where (he/she) found it. (He/She) sleeps soundly that night for the first time in a week.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The fever passes, but the heaviness lingers in a different way: for a long time afterward, (name1) can't bear to go near the jungle edge.

text_only.reason: rule 8: no game has a fitting preference word for the jungle edge (the draft: only where the game has a fitting dislike)

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (name1) carries the stone back to the jungle edge and buries it where (he/she) found it. Was it the stone? Was it just a bad week? (He/She) doesn't know. But that night (he/she) sleeps, and in the morning the food tastes like food again. (name1) doesn't go back to that spot. (He/She) doesn't feel (he/she) needs to.
